_note: Canonical registry of the legal instruments and standards a template field may cite. `regulationRef.instrument` must be one of these keys. Every CELEX below was verified to resolve against the EU Publications Office RDF store (cdm:resource_legal_id_celex). Kinds: `legislation` binds; `standard` supports a presumption of conformity but binds nothing; `scheme` is voluntary; `national` is one member state's law; `specification` is not a reference at all.

32023R1542.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 concerning batteries and waste batteries

32024R1781.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 establishing a framework for the setting of ecodesign requirements
32024R1781.note: Imposes no data field directly. Every DPP obligation flows through a delegated act adopted under Art. 4, and none has been adopted for any product group. Art. 7(2) has sub-points (a), (b), (c) only — there is no 7(2)(d) or 7(2)(e). Annex I lists the product parameters (a)-(t), including (p) microplastic and nanoplastic release.

32024R3110.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/3110 laying down harmonised rules for the marketing of construction products
32024R3110.note: Chapter X (Arts. 75-79) establishes a construction DPP, but the manufacturer duty at Art. 15(7) clocks to 18 months after the Art. 75(1) delegated act, which is not adopted. No operative passport obligation today. CE marking is conditional on coverage by a harmonised technical specification or an ETA.

32025R0040.title: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 on packaging and packaging waste
32025R0040.note: Imposes marking, labelling and a QR data carrier (Art. 12). There is no packaging passport. 'Passport' appears only as a cross-reference to ESPR's.

32023R0988.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 on general product safety
32023R0988.note: Art. 9(5) type/batch/serial or other identifying element; Art. 9(6) manufacturer name, trade mark, postal and electronic address; Art. 11 the same for an importer, conditional on one existing; Art. 16 an EU-established responsible economic operator must exist. Introduces no CE marking.

32019R1020.title: Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 on market surveillance and compliance of products
32019R1020.note: Art. 4 applies only to the closed list of product categories in Art. 4(5) — largely CE-marked ones. It does NOT bite on textiles. For a non-listed product the EU-responsible-person duty comes from GPSR Art. 16 instead. Art. 4(1)-(2) is the basis for the cross-cutting CC-1 rule.

32006R1907.title: Regulation (EC) 1907/2006 concerning the Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals
32006R1907.note: Art. 33(1) discloses to B2B recipients only, and requires the substance name plus safe-use information — not CAS number and concentration. Art. 33(2) to consumers is on request, free, within 45 days. Annex XVII carries the restrictions.

32008R1272.title: Regulation (EC) 1272/2008 on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures

32011L0065.title: Directive 2011/65/EU on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment

32012L0019.title: Directive 2012/19/EU on waste electrical and electronic equipment
32012L0019.note: Art. 14 the crossed-out wheelie-bin marking; Art. 16 producer registration; Annex III the equipment categories.

32020R0740.title: Regulation (EU) 2020/740 on the labelling of tyres with respect to fuel efficiency and other parameters

32017R0821.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/821 laying down supply chain due diligence obligations for importers of tin, tantalum, tungsten and gold

32026R0405.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/405 on detergents and surfactants
32026R0405.note: Mandates a real DPP with a QR data carrier and a central-registry entry, replacing the EU declaration of conformity. The specific article number is not yet verified against primary text.

32009L0048.title: Directive 2009/48/EC on the safety of toys
32009L0048.note: Art. 17 mandates CE marking unconditionally. Still the operative instrument.

32025R2509.title: Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 on the safety of toys
32025R2509.note: In force 1 Jan 2026, applies ~2030. This — not ESPR — is the source of the toy passport.

32011R1007.title: Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 on fibre names and related labelling of textile products
32011R1007.note: Arts. 9(1), 14(1), 16 require fibre names and percentages on a durable, legible, consumer-visible physical label attached to the product. Recording the data in a passport does NOT discharge the obligation. Care labelling is out of scope — it appears only in the Art. 24 review clause.

32011R1169.title: Regulation (EU) 1169/2011 on the provision of food information to consumers

32008L0098.title: Directive 2008/98/EC on waste
32008L0098.note: Art. 9(1)(i) is the basis for SCIP notification to ECHA for SVHCs above 0.1% w/w.

32023R2055.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2055 amending REACH Annex XVII as regards synthetic polymer microparticles
32023R2055.note: Restricts INTENTIONALLY ADDED microplastics. Textile wash-shedding is unintentional and out of scope.

32010R0066.title: Regulation (EC) 66/2010 on the EU Ecolabel
32010R0066.note: Voluntary. Awarding the label is regulated; carrying it is not required of any product.

32023R0956.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 establishing a carbon border adjustment mechanism
32023R0956.note: The EU publishes no RDF vocabulary for CBAM terms. Cite the instrument; the concepts have no dereferenceable IRI.

32003L0087.title: Directive 2003/87/EC establishing a scheme for greenhouse gas emission allowance trading

32004L0042.title: Directive 2004/42/EC on the limitation of emissions of volatile organic compounds due to the use of organic solvents in certain paints and varnishes

32024R1257.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1257 on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines (Euro 7)
32024R1257.note: Tyre abrasion limits are pending a delegated act; not yet in force.

32012R0528.title: Regulation (EU) 528/2012 concerning the making available on the market and use of biocidal products

32018R0848.title: Regulation (EU) 2018/848 on organic production and labelling of organic products

32009R0661.title: Regulation (EC) 661/2009 concerning type-approval requirements for the general safety of motor vehicles

32004R0648.title: Regulation (EC) 648/2004 on detergents
32004R0648.note: Being repealed by Reg. (EU) 2026/405 from 23 Sep 2029.

32023R1464.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1464 amending REACH Annex XVII as regards formaldehyde and formaldehyde releasers

31989L0459.title: Directive 89/459/EEC on the tread depth of tyres of certain categories of motor vehicles

32023R1670.title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/1670 laying down ecodesign requirements for smartphones and slate tablets
32023R1670.note: Under the OLD Ecodesign Directive 2009/125/EC, not ESPR. Real durability/repairability/spare-parts obligations for smartphones and tablets, but no Digital Product Passport.

nonLegislative._note: References that are not EU legislation. A field may cite one, but it must carry the right `kind` so nothing implies a legal obligation.

standard.description: Supports a presumption of conformity. Creates no obligation on its own.

scheme.description: Voluntary certification or industry scheme. Not law.

national.description: One member state's law. Not an EU-wide obligation.

specification.description: Not a reference at all — a product spec, a safety-data-sheet section, or a note. These must be removed from regulationRef.
